children: ESAB Corporation (“ESAB” or the “Company”) (NYSE: ESAB), a focused premier industrial compounder, announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share of the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on October 16, 2026 to shareholders of record as of October 2, 2026.
